en.headline: Immigration records over 1.32 million crossings on Chung Yeung Sunday
en.dek: Huanggang Port handled its highest daily total since reopening, with more than 152,000 trips, as overall traffic across all control points exceeded 1.32 million.
body: The Immigration Department said more than 1.322 million passenger trips were recorded across all control points on Sunday, 18 October, the day of the Chung Yeung Festival, with outbound trips exceeding 690,000 and inbound trips near 630,000.

Hong Kong residents accounted for more than 530,000 of the outbound trips, while mainland visitors made up more than 98,000 of the arrivals. The newly reopened Huanggang Port handled about 152,068 trips, the highest daily figure since it began operations on 12 October, including roughly 77,000 outbound and 75,000 inbound.

Lo Wu recorded the largest volume at nearly 260,000 trips, followed by the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line with more than 200,000. Authorities had earlier noted heavy outbound traffic at Huanggang around midday on Sunday and deployed extra staff and all clearance channels to manage the flow.

zh.headline: 重陽節全日逾132萬人次出入境 新皇崗口岸15.2萬創開通新高
zh.dek: 入境處指星期日各口岸合共錄得超過132.2萬人次，其中皇崗口岸約15.2萬人次為啟用以來最多。
body: 入境處數據顯示，重陽節正日（18日）全港各管制站共錄得超過132.2萬人次出入境，其中出境逾69萬人次，入境近63萬人次。
出境方面，香港居民超過53萬人次；入境旅客中，內地旅客超過9.8萬人次。重建後的皇崗口岸錄得約15.2萬人次出入境，是自10月12日開通以來最多，香港居民佔當中不少部分。
按口岸計算，最多人使用羅湖管制站，近26萬人次；其次是落馬洲支線管制站，逾20萬人次。保安局較早前指皇崗口岸中午時段北上人流顯著增加，入境處已即時加派人手及開放所有通道疏導。
